_comment: Interface strings. Key-major so the two languages sit side by side for review. Swahili is a DRAFT pending review by a first-language speaker with business exposure (docs/localization.md). Placeholders in {braces} must survive translation; whole sentences only, never assembled from fragments.

foot.privacy.en: Your progress stays on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
foot.privacy.sw: Maendeleo yako yanabaki kwenye simu hii. Hakuna kinachotumwa popote.

banner.unverified.en: Practice figures — the money amounts here are made up for teaching, not real local prices.
banner.unverified.sw: Namba za mazoezi — kiasi cha pesa hapa kimetungwa kwa ajili ya kufundisha, si bei halisi za hapa.

banner.draftLanguage.en: The Kiswahili here is a first draft and has not yet been checked by a first-language speaker.
banner.draftLanguage.sw: Kiswahili hiki ni rasimu ya kwanza, bado hakijapitiwa na mzungumzaji wa lugha ya kwanza.

cash.depreciation.en: Wear on equipment, which took no money
cash.depreciation.sw: Uchakavu wa vifaa, ambao haukutoa pesa

cash.workingCapitalChange.en: Money tied up in stock and unpaid invoices
cash.workingCapitalChange.sw: Pesa iliyofungwa kwenye bidhaa na madeni ya wateja

pnl.newTitle.en: New in your ledger this week
pnl.newTitle.sw: Mpya katika daftari lako wiki hii

worth.lenderShare.en: For every 100 of this that is yours, the lender is owed {amount}.
worth.lenderShare.sw: Kwa kila 100 ya hii iliyo yako, mkopeshaji anadai {amount}.

worth.outweighed.en: More is owed than you hold. The interest and the repayment carry on in a bad week too.
worth.outweighed.sw: Kinachodaiwa ni zaidi ya unachoshikilia. Riba na marejesho vinaendelea hata wiki mbaya.

worth.owesMoreThanOwns.en: The business owes more than it owns. Everything it holds is spoken for.
worth.owesMoreThanOwns.sw: Biashara inadaiwa zaidi ya inavyomiliki. Kila kitu ilicho nacho kimeshadaiwa.

pnl.new.worth.en: This is everything the business owns — cash, equipment at what it is worth now, stock and money customers owe — less what it owes. It is the one number here that adds up week after week. Money you spend or take home comes out of it; money you leave in stays in it.
pnl.new.worth.sw: Hii ni kila kitu biashara inamiliki — pesa, vifaa kwa thamani yake ya sasa, stock na pesa wateja wanazodaiwa — ukiondoa inachodaiwa. Ndilo namba pekee hapa inayojumlika wiki hadi wiki. Pesa unayotumia au kupeleka nyumbani inatoka humo; unayoacha ndani inabaki humo.

pnl.new.gearing.en: A loan does not change what the business owns, only how much of it is yours. The more the lender is owed against your own stake, the less room a bad season leaves you.
pnl.new.gearing.sw: Mkopo haubadilishi biashara inamiliki nini, unabadilisha ni kiasi gani ni chako. Kadri mkopeshaji anavyodaiwa zaidi ukilinganisha na fungu lako, ndivyo msimu mbaya unavyokuachia nafasi ndogo.

pnl.new.spoilage.en: What you made and could not sell. It cost money to make and earned none.
pnl.new.spoilage.sw: Ulichotengeneza na usiweze kuuza. Kiligharimu pesa kutengeneza na hakikuleta kitu.

pnl.new.depreciation.en: Your equipment wearing out, spread across its working life. It is a real cost, but no money leaves the bank this week.
pnl.new.depreciation.sw: Vifaa vyako vinavyochakaa, gharama ikigawanywa katika maisha yake ya kazi. Ni gharama halisi, lakini hakuna pesa inayotoka benki wiki hii.

pnl.new.interest.en: Interest on what you owe. This is a cost. Repaying the loan itself is not a cost — that is cash leaving, shown further down.
pnl.new.interest.sw: Riba ya deni lako. Hii ni gharama. Kulipa mkopo wenyewe si gharama — hiyo ni pesa inayotoka, imeonyeshwa hapa chini.

pnl.new.freight.en: Shipping what you send abroad. It is charged on exported units only.
pnl.new.freight.sw: Usafirishaji wa unachopeleka nje. Unatozwa kwa vipande vilivyosafirishwa nje pekee.

pnl.new.duty.en: Duty on what you sell abroad. It is charged on the value you export.
pnl.new.duty.sw: Ushuru wa unachouza nje. Unatozwa kwa thamani unayosafirisha nje.

pnl.new.fxGain.en: The exchange rate moved your way, so money earned abroad is worth more here.
pnl.new.fxGain.sw: Kiwango cha ubadilishaji kimekwenda upande wako, kwa hiyo pesa iliyopatikana nje ina thamani zaidi hapa.

pnl.new.fxLoss.en: The exchange rate moved against you, so money earned abroad is worth less here.
pnl.new.fxLoss.sw: Kiwango cha ubadilishaji kimekwenda kinyume nawe, kwa hiyo pesa iliyopatikana nje ina thamani ndogo hapa.

pnl.perUnit.en: Each one you sell brings in {price} and costs you {cost}, so you keep {kept}.
pnl.perUnit.sw: Kila kimoja unachouza kinaingiza {price} na kinakugharimu {cost}, kwa hiyo unabaki na {kept}.

pnl.unmet.one.en: {n} customer wanted to buy and you had nothing left.
pnl.unmet.one.sw: Mteja {n} alitaka kununua lakini hukuwa na kitu.

pnl.unmet.other.en: {n} customers wanted to buy and you had nothing left.
pnl.unmet.other.sw: Wateja {n} walitaka kununua lakini hukuwa na kitu.

pnl.cashRunway.one.en: Your cash covers about {n} more week of rent and wages.
pnl.cashRunway.one.sw: Pesa yako inatosha kulipa kodi na mishahara kwa wiki {n} zaidi.

pnl.cashRunway.other.en: Your cash covers about {n} more weeks of rent and wages.
pnl.cashRunway.other.sw: Pesa yako inatosha kulipa kodi na mishahara kwa wiki {n} zaidi.

workout.intro.en: This is where you stand right now, before your choice takes effect.
workout.intro.sw: Hapa ndipo ulipo sasa, kabla uamuzi wako haujaanza kufanya kazi.

workout.ready.en: Now say what your choice will do to that.

predict.question.en: What happens to your weekly profit?

secondLook.nothing.en: None of the lines moved much. That is why the profit barely changed.
secondLook.nothing.sw: Hakuna kipengele kilichobadilika sana. Ndiyo maana faida haikubadilika sana.

later.title.en: This came from an earlier choice
later.title.sw: Hii imetokana na uamuzi wa awali

trajectory.cash.en: In {weeks} weeks your cash would be about {amount}.
trajectory.cash.sw: Baada ya wiki {weeks} pesa yako itakuwa karibu {amount}.

trajectory.falling.en: It is going down. Something has to change.

profile.improved.en: You got better as you went on.

profile.limitationsTitle.en: What this does not tell you

profile.recapIntro.en: One idea per week, and what you did about it.
profile.recapIntro.sw: Wazo moja kila wiki, na ulichofanya kuhusu hilo.

profile.finished.body.en: Finishing is what carries you forward — not how many predictions you got right. Your record goes with you, and what it shows is used at the next stage, not to score you here.
profile.finished.body.sw: Kumaliza ndiko kunakupeleka mbele — si idadi ya utabiri uliopata sahihi. Kumbukumbu yako inaenda nawe, na inachoonyesha kinatumika hatua inayofuata, si kukupa alama hapa.

profile.stmt.calibration.en: Correctly anticipated the effect of their own decision in {correct} of {total} predictions.
profile.stmt.calibration.sw: Alitabiri kwa usahihi matokeo ya uamuzi wake katika utabiri {correct} kati ya {total}.

profile.detail.improved.en: Accuracy was higher in the second half of the playthrough than the first.
profile.detail.improved.sw: Usahihi ulikuwa juu zaidi katika nusu ya pili kuliko ya kwanza.

profile.detail.declined.en: Accuracy was lower in the second half than the first.
profile.detail.declined.sw: Usahihi ulikuwa chini katika nusu ya pili kuliko ya kwanza.

profile.detail.steady.en: Accuracy was broadly steady across the playthrough.
profile.detail.steady.sw: Usahihi ulikuwa sawa kwa kiasi kikubwa katika mchezo mzima.

profile.stmt.information.en: Sought information before deciding in {withInfo} of {total} decisions.
profile.stmt.information.sw: Alitafuta taarifa kabla ya kuamua katika maamuzi {withInfo} kati ya {total}.

profile.stmt.recovery.one.en: Faced {n} decision that reduced weekly profit, and continued afterwards.
profile.stmt.recovery.one.sw: Alikutana na uamuzi {n} uliopunguza faida ya wiki, na akaendelea baadaye.

profile.stmt.recovery.other.en: Faced {n} decisions that reduced weekly profit, and continued afterwards.
profile.stmt.recovery.other.sw: Alikutana na maamuzi {n} yaliyopunguza faida ya wiki, na akaendelea baadaye.

profile.detail.recovery.en: What they chose next is listed in the evidence below.
profile.detail.recovery.sw: Alichochagua baadaye kimeorodheshwa katika ushahidi hapa chini.

profile.stmt.coverage.one.sw: Alifanya maamuzi katika mada {n} ya biashara.

profile.stmt.coverage.other.sw: Alifanya maamuzi katika mada {n} za biashara.

profile.stmt.diagnosis.en: Named the line that explained what happened correctly in {correct} of {total} checks.
profile.stmt.diagnosis.sw: Alitaja mstari uliofafanua kilichotokea kwa usahihi katika ukaguzi {correct} kati ya {total}.

profile.stmt.goal.en: Met {met} of {total} goal conditions in the simulation.
profile.stmt.goal.sw: Alifikia masharti {met} kati ya {total} ya lengo katika kiigizo.

profile.limit.1.en: This describes what happened inside a simulation. It is not a measure of how this person runs a real business.
profile.limit.1.sw: Haya yanaeleza yaliyotokea ndani ya kiigizo. Si kipimo cha jinsi mtu huyu anavyoendesha biashara halisi.

profile.limit.2.en: It has not been validated against real business outcomes. No such study exists yet.
profile.limit.2.sw: Hayajathibitishwa dhidi ya matokeo halisi ya biashara. Hakuna utafiti wa aina hiyo bado.

profile.limit.3.en: It should not be used as an automatic cut-off, or to rank one person against another.
profile.limit.3.sw: Hayapaswi kutumika kama kigezo cha kukata mtu moja kwa moja, wala kupanga mtu mmoja dhidi ya mwingine.

profile.limit.4.en: Figures in the simulation are illustrative placeholders, not researched local data.
profile.limit.4.sw: Namba zilizomo katika kiigizo ni za mfano tu, si takwimu za hapa zilizofanyiwa utafiti.

num.prompt.en: Choose the number you will use.

num.grossPerWeek.en: You keep {kept} on each one. About {units} sales a week, so {gross} before rent and wages.
num.grossPerWeek.sw: Unabaki na {kept} kwa kila kimoja. Takriban mauzo {units} kwa wiki, kwa hiyo {gross} kabla ya kodi na mishahara.

num.customersLost.en: At this price, you expect to lose {n} customers.
num.customersLost.sw: Kwa bei hii, unatarajia kupoteza wateja {n}.

num.customersGained.en: At this price, you expect {n} more customers.
num.customersGained.sw: Kwa bei hii, unatarajia wateja {n} zaidi.

num.noChange.en: No linked number changes at this value.
num.noChange.sw: Hakuna namba inayohusiana inayobadilika kwa namba hii.

num.predictPrompt.en: What do you think the weekly profit will be?
num.predictPrompt.sw: Unafikiri faida ya wiki itakuwa kiasi gani?

num.predictFixed.en: You keep {kept} on each sale, and rent, wages and fees take {fixed} a week.
num.predictFixed.sw: Unabaki na {kept} kwa kila mauzo, na kodi, mishahara na ada vinachukua {fixed} kwa wiki.

num.predictFixedMix.en: Your products together keep {kept} a week after ingredients, and rent, wages and fees take {fixed}.
num.predictFixedMix.sw: Bidhaa zako kwa pamoja zinabakiza {kept} kwa wiki baada ya viungo, na kodi, mishahara na ada vinachukua {fixed}.

alloc.allAllocated.en: All of the amount is allocated.

alloc.decreaseLabel.en: Move one step out of this bucket
alloc.decreaseLabel.sw: Toa hatua moja kwenye kikapu hiki

alloc.increaseLabel.en: Move one step into this bucket
alloc.increaseLabel.sw: Ongeza hatua moja kwenye kikapu hiki

alloc.coarseDecreaseLabel.en: Move five steps out of this bucket
alloc.coarseDecreaseLabel.sw: Toa hatua tano kwenye kikapu hiki

alloc.coarseIncreaseLabel.en: Move five steps into this bucket
alloc.coarseIncreaseLabel.sw: Ongeza hatua tano kwenye kikapu hiki

chapter.selectIntro.en: Four businesses, one owner. Each one takes about half an hour and stands on its own.
chapter.selectIntro.sw: Biashara nne, mmiliki mmoja. Kila moja inachukua takribani nusu saa na inajitegemea.

chapter.notALadder.en: This is not a ladder. A stall run well is a real business, not a step towards a bigger one. Start with whichever is closest to yours.
chapter.notALadder.sw: Hii si ngazi. Kibanda kinachoendeshwa vizuri ni biashara halisi, si hatua kuelekea kubwa zaidi. Anza na ile inayofanana zaidi na yako.

chapter.unavailable.en: This chapter is not ready yet. Choose another one.
chapter.unavailable.sw: Sura hii bado haijakamilika. Chagua nyingine.

pnl.why.depreciation.en: The wear on your equipment was counted as a cost, but no money left your hand for it — so {amount} of this week's profit is still with you.
pnl.why.depreciation.sw: Uchakavu wa vifaa vyako ulihesabiwa kama gharama, lakini hakuna pesa iliyotoka mkononi mwako — hivyo {amount} ya faida ya wiki hii bado iko nawe.

pnl.why.repayment.en: {amount} went to the loan. That is money leaving your hand, and it is not counted as a cost.
pnl.why.repayment.sw: {amount} ilikwenda kwenye mkopo. Hiyo ni pesa inayotoka mkononi mwako, na haihesabiwi kama gharama.

pnl.why.workingCapital.en: You have earned this money but not yet received it. It is sitting with your customers, or on your shelf as stock.
pnl.why.workingCapital.sw: Umeipata pesa hii lakini bado hujaipokea. Iko kwa wateja wako, au rafuni kama bidhaa.
